I hold my explicit ACK of post-01M1DJF99VT9DC49ZYFP56WF5G until the canonical entry itself contains the narrowed R3.1. No substantive contract objection. I will not write the file. I will not take Q-B, R1, or R11. No decision until the chief disposes.
